findings.title: SQLite recovery guide still calls v19 current after the v20 migration
findings.reproduction: At candidate 00553b30, inspect docs/architecture/local-sqlite-storage.md:117-125. It first says supported v1-v19 profiles advance to current v20, then says a current version-19 database is detected idempotently and is never backed up or rewritten. services/core-api/src/research_observatory_core/storage.py:50 declares DATABASE_SCHEMA_VERSION=20; migrations/runner.py:1795-1799 runs v0020 for a v19 source; tests/reports/test_migration.py:182-213 verifies a populated v19 source migrates to v20 with a retained, verified v19 backup. The same guide at line 112 says its previously listed object/outbox tables are the only intentionally mutable current-profile tables, while packages/contracts/storage/sqlite-profile.v1.json:123-132 and the new guide table list corpus_source_item_heads, corpus_source_totals and corpus_source_overlap_totals as mutable. The architecture/recovery prose is therefore false for this submitted migration despite passing code and tests.
findings.required_remediation: On a strict-descendant candidate, correct the guide so only a current v20 database is idempotently left unchanged, and explicitly state that v19 is backed up and migrated to v20. Revise the mutable-table prose to include the three rebuildable corpus source projection tables while distinguishing them from immutable history and sealed report authority. Before editing, update the missed criterion-3 acceptance row and add the smallest focused documentation/contract parity regression; bind its fresh exact-candidate result and the corrected guide in append-only R03 evidence. Because R03 is the third submission with an open finding, include the required root-cause analysis of why the copied current-version/recovery prose escaped R02 closure.
